headline: TBR @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.35 at TOR 3.80, with a projected total of 8.15. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved +0.34 runs while TOR moved -0.18, changing the projected margin by +0.51 runs. Pitching context: Shane McClanahan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Kazuma Okamoto, Chandler Simpson, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Davis Schneider because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
